name: @scetrov/blender-pi
description: Artist-approved Pi integration for a live Blender 5.2+ session
author: scetrov

scripts.format: biome format --write package.json biome.json tsconfig.json extensions protocol tests/unit
scripts.format:check: biome format package.json biome.json tsconfig.json extensions protocol tests/unit
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run python:check && npm test
